assessment_objectives.objective: Control Assurance Automation (CAA) engineering pipelines, tooling and automated collection are identified and documented as technology functions within the scope of the organization's governance.

Control Assurance Automation (CAA) engineering pipelines, tooling and automated collection are included in the organization's risk assessment and risk register activities in the same manner as other technology functions.

Control Assurance Automation (CAA) engineering pipelines, tooling and automated collection are subject to the same governance requirements applied to other technology functions, including ownership, access management, change management and monitoring.
responsibility and authority for the governance and risk oversight of Control Assurance Automation (CAA) are assigned to designated personnel.
governance and risk oversight of Control Assurance Automation (CAA) is reviewed at a defined frequency.
